rules.title: Vacancy decontrol: new tenant's initial rent capped at 25% over prior rent
rules.requirement: When a registered rent-controlled unit is voluntarily vacated, the landlord may raise the rent for the next tenant by no more than 25% over the last rent paid, excluding any capital improvement surcharge. After that, later increases for the new tenant are again subject to Hoboken rent control, using the new rent as the base rent.
rules.key_value: 25% over last rent paid by vacating tenant

coverage.summary: Rent-controlled apartment units in Hoboken that are registered under § 155-30, upon a qualifying vacancy. This excerpt does not state which buildings Chapter 155 covers.

rules.exemptions: Capital improvement surcharge in the last rent is excluded from the 25% computation.
rules.penalty: If decontrol is improper, the Rent Board may rescind it, roll back the rent, and prosecute under § 155-21.
rules.quoted_span: Provided that a dwelling is registered in accordance with § 155-30 upon the vacation of a residential apartment unit by a tenant, the apartment unit shall become decontrolled and exempt from the provisions of this chapter for the new tenant's initial rental; provided, however, that said rental shall be limited to an increase of 25% over the last rental paid by the tenant who voluntarily vacated the rental unit, exclusive of any capital improvement surcharge that is a component of said last rental.

rules.title: Vacancy decontrol allowed only after voluntary vacancy or lawful eviction
rules.requirement: A landlord may use vacancy decontrol only if the tenant left voluntarily without harassment or pressure, was legally evicted, or left under a court order (not a holdover-only order). A tenant pressured out can ask the Rent Control Board for a hearing; the Board may rescind decontrol and restore the prior rent.

coverage.summary: Hoboken rent-controlled apartment units for which a landlord seeks vacancy decontrol.

rules.penalty: Rescission of decontrol, rent reverts to prior rent, and prosecution under § 155-21.
rules.quoted_span: If the Board finds that a landlord is seeking to decontrol or has decontrolled an apartment unit and the tenant has vacated the unit under circumstances other than those set forth in this section, the Rent Board may rescind the decontrol of the apartment unit, and the rent shall revert to that rental on the apartment unit prior to the vacation of the apartment, and prosecute the landlord for violation of the chapter under § 155-21.

rules.title: Vacancy decontrol limited to once every three years
rules.requirement: A Hoboken rent-controlled unit may be decontrolled at vacancy no more than once in any three-year period. If your unit got a vacancy increase within the past three years, a new vacancy increase is not allowed.

coverage.summary: Hoboken rent-controlled dwelling units subject to vacancy decontrol under Article VII.

rules.quoted_span: No dwelling unit shall be decontrolled pursuant to this article more than once in any three-year period.

notes: Excerpt of Hoboken Chapter 155 Article VII (vacancy decontrol).
